parsed.explanation: The combined regime is High Risk: federal document/entry rules can block or permanently bar mismatched travellers, and state/federal facility bans plus criminal bathroom enforcement create unavoidable public-space exposure. Immigration and correctional custody report severe abuse; minors face care bans, school restrictions, and criminalized social transition. Partial courts/local protections create uncertainty but do not provide traveller-facing relief. Adult alone faces exclusion/detention risk; travelling with a minor adds care denial/investigation. No credible execution, so above Severe.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport/visa rules force M/F sex assigned at birth; X markers blocked. Document discrepancies trigger entry refusal, evidence demands, possible permanent fraud inadmissibility. Travellers report passports confiscated/blocked and stranding; foreign advisories.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid; fraud findings require all elements and have limited waivers. Courts are litigating but policy allowed; legal-aid FAQ gives planning advice, not traveller-facing remedy.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch can escalate at border from questioning to refusal/deportment, investigation, detention, then facility/custody rules.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse for transgender men. Corrections bureau adopted conversion therapy: hair cuts, hormone removal, psychiatric treatment; transgender inmates denied care; stopped reporting.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Some orders enjoined; courts/civil-liberties litigation and ombuds-style mechanisms exist, but no documented operative relief for detained trans visitors.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document mismatch or facility arrest can produce custody; placement and care follow hostile birth-sex/conversion rules.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National bar on congruent government-funded facilities. Many states/provinces ban identity-congruent facilities in schools/government buildings, some private settings, and four criminalize certain use. Documented bathroom arrest at capitol, 60-day exposure, men's ward.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Map shows jurisdictions without bans and municipal/public accommodations in some areas; exemptions and refusal requirement limit automatic arrest.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal rule plus state criminal/trespass exposure means outed traveller can face eviction, questioning, detention in congruent spaces.

care_services.exposure: Minors banned from puberty blockers/hormones in many states, with funding and insurance attacks; schools investigated/prosecuted for social transition; records subpoenaed. Adult travel medication/HRT not documented.
care_services.protection: Not documented as operative traveller-facing care assurance; some care bans litigated, but no safe-continuity rule shown.
care_services.interaction: A travelling family may be denied continuity care; provider liability and mandated investigations can force outing/denial.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: EOs erase gender terminology, rescind pronoun/name policies, freeze funding, ban military/trans athletes, direct criminal prosecutions for teachers. Reward memo associates radical gender ideology with violence; counterterrorism prioritizes pro-transgender groups.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Official statement says counterterrorism not used against mere disagreement; employment ruling and hate-crime law exist; some orders blocked.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing legitimizes document checks, facility policing, investigations and hostile custody; partial courts create uncertainty.

minors_guardians.exposure: Public-school facility restriction, minor care ban with no phase-out, sport bans, criminal exposure for teachers facilitating social transition; records subpoenas. Families may lose care/school access.
minors_guardians.protection: Some municipal non-discrimination, conversion-therapy ban, employment protections; none documented as protecting visiting minors' care/schooling.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian or provider actions can trigger investigation, denial of continuity care, missed schooling, separation of care from travelling child.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No current documented trans-specific street attack pattern; however, public support for birth-sex rules is high, some jurisdictions flagged Do Not Travel, and one bias case used sexual-orientation statute not gender identity.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 22 jurisdictions protect discrimination; municipal ordinances exist. Enforcement outcomes for visitors unknown.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Hostile climate and thin local bias coverage can worsen police response; documented arrests may invite abuse without showing rates.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Unclear which orders/enjoined rules apply at moment; border discretion; private/public facilities enforcement; device searches; adult HRT/customs; consular access.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Active litigation, legal-aid FAQ, courts can enjoin; some state protections. But no reliable traveller-facing remedy for immediate entry/custody.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Partial judicial relief reduces certainty but does not neutralize operative federal entry, facility, custody, minor-care rules.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in birth-sex custody/facility abuse and visitor-facing criminal risk. Here document/entry screening and minor-care rules are broader, but no weekly raids or automatic imprisonment; severe custody abuse is documented yet not certain. Rates near 0.25-0.30.

Below 0.35-A because border exclusion is only one component. This dossier adds criminal facility exposure, permanent fraud bars, arrest, and severe detention patterns. 0.35-A is discretionary denial without prison pathway, so its consequence is less severe here.

Higher than 0.55-C, which has uneven health-ward delays and advocate remedies. This dossier adds national document/facility criminalization, immigration custody abuse, and minor-care prohibitions, though some courts and local protections keep it from the low band.

Far below 0.75-C: no reliable respectful border training, no operative traveller protection against birth-sex documents/facilities, and hostile custody/minor-care rules. 0.75-C has predictable release/appeals; here refusal, fraud, detention, and investigation can follow discovery.

parsed.synthesis: Document mismatch at entry/facilities is primary exposure, escalating to refusal, investigation, detention under birth-sex/conversion rules. Federal hostility, state bans/criminal provisions, and minor-care prohibitions make severe consequences likely for outed travellers. Local protections and injunctions reduce frequency but not operative risk. Adults alone bear high friction/exclusion; families with minors bear higher care/school exposure and guardian/provider investigation.
